title: System prompts
summary: Inspect the prompt used by an agent role, edit its startup instructions or compose role-specific reusable sections.

workflows.label: Change an agent's startup instructions
workflows.summary: Update the prompt file for the agent scope you intend to affect, then inspect the rendered result.

entry.prerequisite: Know whether this is a project-local, global or bundled agent; local project definitions take precedence.

steps.action: Open Settings → Prompts (or type /prompts in Web chat), choose the role you want to inspect, and open Full Prompt.
For a project agent, edit .kollab/agents/<agent-name>/system_prompt.md in that project workspace.
Make a focused change and save. Keep reusable fragments in that agent's sections/ directory and include one with <trender type="include" path="sections/verify.md" />.
Reload the agent, return to Settings → Prompts, select the same role and open Full Prompt to confirm the intended text is present.

commands.description: Open the System Prompts panel in the Web chat.
commands.expect: Settings → Prompts shows the current role's available sections and Full Prompt preview.

media.alt: Kollab Prompts settings showing a role's sections and rendered prompt
media.caption: Select a role, inspect Full Prompt, then reload after changing its startup instructions.

workflows.success: The selected role's rendered system prompt contains the saved instruction or included section.

recovery.symptom: Your edits do not appear in the prompt
recovery.action: Check whether a higher-priority project or global agent definition overrides the one you edited, then reload the agent and inspect the role in Settings → Prompts → Full Prompt.
Verify the section path is relative to the agent directory, the file exists in sections/, and the include syntax is exact.

workflows.note: Prompt files are not Agent Skills. Skills use their own directory contract and a SKILL.md file; assign them separately through agent metadata.

workflows.label: Choose sections for an agent role
workflows.summary: Include a shared prompt section for one role and inspect the assembled prompt before relying on it.

steps.action: In Settings → Prompts, select the target under Roles and choose the relevant model variant.
Find the section you want and enable its checkbox for this role; the role composition saves automatically.
Select a section to edit its text, choose Edit, make the change and select Save for this role or Save to Library as appropriate.
Select Full Prompt to review the assembled prompt and confirm the section appears for the chosen role and variant.
To create shared content first, select or create a library with New library, then use New section; return to the role and include that section.

commands.description: Open Settings → Prompts in the Web chat.
commands.expect: The page offers Libraries, Roles, model variants, section selection, editing and Full Prompt.

workflows.success: The chosen role and model variant include the intended section in their Full Prompt; other roles remain unchanged unless the shared library section itself was edited.

recovery.symptom: The section is missing from the full prompt
recovery.action: Confirm you selected the intended role and model variant, then enable its section checkbox and inspect Full Prompt again.

recovery.symptom: You changed text for more roles than intended
recovery.action: If you edited a shared library section, use the role-specific section override or restore the library text, then inspect affected roles' Full Prompt.
